procedure: Collect independent frozen SONIC parent per new course, then independent 0.55 m and 0.95 m acquisition arms with the same frozen actor, asset, runner and course parent. Audit all 48 new physics episodes.
analysis: Combine with v278 development bank only after source/asset/actor hashes agree. Leave one seed out across all four seeds. Precontact-only selector must beat training-fold fixed arm on every test seed and avoid out-of-play and body-safety regressions before any fresh holdout.
